canonicalCoordinates: +Y up,+Z forward,+X character left; metres; quaternionxyzw

channelSemantics.pelvisLocalPositionMetres: ABSOLUTE canonical bone.position including rest hipsY.95; NOT native PoseBone.location/rest delta
channelSemantics.pelvisOffsetMetres: AUDIT ONLY sampled additive difference from exact captured baseline local position; not normative interpolated control
channelSemantics.pelvisQuaternion: ABSOLUTE unit canonical-local bone quaternion XYZW; assign/blend, never multiply as delta
channelSemantics.upperBodyAndHands: ABSOLUTE unit canonical-local quaternions XYZW; split fingers after existing hand-target owner and before temporal filtering
channelSemantics.kneePoleRootSpace: Unit directions in actor root canonical frame; interpolate then normalize; no targets/root/clocks

interpolation.normative: Periodic cubic Hermite per scalar component using explicit per-phase tangents; normalize quaternion/direction results; native poses use same periodic Hermite handles
interpolation.nativeIKLimitation: Native49 solved leg curves approximate true same-target re-solve between dense keys; runtime must freeze baseline plan then solve at actual sample, not import native leg tracks
